title: Oliver Muldoon band and sending for his father
summary: He joined the good but underemployed Oliver Muldoon band in Little Rock, then wired his father for help; his mother had died when he was ten.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Then I joined the best band down there, Oliver Muldoon. Have you ever heard of that band?
In Little Rock. But the only thing about

that band was that they didn't work enough, you know. That's why I had to work with Big To-Do, you know. I had to get some gigs, because they didn't work enough. Then finally it just caved in on me, and I just... That was the first time I ever had to send to my father to send for me, you know.
Yeah, I was going to ask about that. Were you in touch with your folks at all during that time?
Were they angry at you for...?
No, no. My mother had died, you know. And my father, he didn't take it too well(?) ..(?)... away from home.
Oh, when I was about ten years old, I guess. I... "Don't send for me to come back." Tou know how it is! Heh-heh.
